shared_elements: stone relief panel with single dominant figure
patterned/textured infill of garment or costume
raised low-relief carving on a rectangular slab
justification: Both depict a single human figure in profile wearing an elaborate headdress and ornaments, carved in low relief on a rectangular slab, and both use dense patterned infill for costume detail — but these are generic to much figural relief. A depicts only a bust/head close-up with a naturalistic, tightly ordered curl-by-curl beard and hair and no accompanying signs, whereas B shows a full standing figure with held objects, an ornate mask-like headdress and framing bands of glyph-like blocks, an entirely different compositional and stylistic scheme.
